title: View, continue or compare periodontal charts
summary: Find the periodontal charts in the clinical record, open them and compare them with today.

steps.title: Menu → Patients
steps.details: Patient list; tapping one opens their record on the right.

steps.title: Open their record
steps.details: Tap the patient in the list.

steps.title: Clinical record
steps.details: The patient's sessions, odontogram, periodontal chart and documents.

steps.title: Timeline
steps.details: All sessions, from the most recent to the oldest.

steps.title: Filter
steps.details: With the “Periodontal chart” filter only those remain.

steps.title: Tap a periodontal chart
steps.details: Expand it: the preview of both arches (or the sextants, for a screening), the type, the diagnosis and the indices.

steps.title: Compare with today
steps.details: On one that is not the latest: opens the most recent on Progress, compared with that one.

steps.title: Delete
steps.details: Only if it is not closed: a closed one is clinical record.

steps.title: Continue or view
steps.details: Opens the periodontal chart: to keep recording it or, if closed, to view and amend it.
